purpose: Test whether the missing isolated O14 h0=0 event root is explained by a competing surface-storage cap/runoff-onset event occurring first. This changes event topology only; it does not change Ross physics, material parameters, forcing cases, tau floor or the qualified surface-face law.

upstream.A3_observation: 0 reproducible isolated h0=0 roots across 24 frozen cases and 288 deterministic reference-only multistarts even after allowing h1,h2 up to -1e-8 cm.

preserved_controls_from_A2.meaning: The three already characterized positive materials reach h0=0 well before the 1 cm surface cap. A4 is therefore an O14-specific competing-event diagnostic, not a universal change to event ordering.

competing_event_equations.event: surface storage reaches Smax=1 cm with runoff still exactly zero at onset
competing_event_equations.soil_equations: Three unchanged conservative backward-Euler cell balances over tau.
competing_event_equations.surface_equation: (1.0-S0) - tau*(q_supply-q_top) = 0; runoff is zero exactly at onset.

surface_flux_authority.search_flux: Use the already restricted-qualified bounded 5 cm surface-face candidate only as a deterministic root-search aid.
surface_flux_authority.evidence_flux: At every candidate event root recompute q_top with the independent high-accuracy exact 5 cm surface reference and recompute all four balances. Only the independent-reference residual may qualify a root as diagnostic evidence.

event_order_classification.NO_REPRODUCIBLE_SURFACE_CAP_ROOT: no reproducible independently verified surface-cap root

reproducibility.multiple_distinct_clusters: Record all; do not silently choose one.

decision_logic.surface_cap_precedes: The A3 isolated h0 event is not the first admissible event for those O14 cases. Next gate must compose runoff onset first, then continue toward top saturation transactionally.
decision_logic.coevent: Surface cap and top saturation must be treated as a coupled event; next gate must solve/commit both event consequences atomically.
decision_logic.no_surface_cap_root: The missing O14 event is not explained by the 1 cm cap under this frozen discretization; investigate a more general complementarity/trajectory formulation rather than extending grids or lowering tau.

hard_guards: Do not modify the 24 A2 O14 profile x supply cases.
Do not lower the 1e-8 d tau floor or enlarge the 1 cm surface-storage scope.
Do not alter O14 hydraulics, Ross face physics, numerical accuracy gates or bottom boundary.
Do not count a search-solver root unless the independent high-accuracy surface reference closes the balances within 1e-9 cm.
Do not qualify production behavior from A4.
Do not infer that runoff must occur for B01/B12/O13; their preserved A2 top-saturation fixtures remain authoritative.

architecture_checks.transactionality: All search trials are scratch only; committed soil and surface state are immutable.
architecture_checks.mass_conservation: Independent-reference recomputed balances remain a hard 1e-9 cm gate.
architecture_checks.physics_solver_policy_separation: Only the competing event constraint changes; physics and forcing remain frozen.
architecture_checks.bounded_cost: 24 fixed cases x 12 fixed starts; no adaptive case generation.
